scope.data_scope: Saved aggregate statistics, receipts and code only.

interpretation.auc: Final combined AUC is computable in both windows and both classifier families. No saved H1 rejects; each H2 remains NOT_TESTED because its within-family gate did not open. This does not mean numerical non-verifiability or prove zero information.
interpretation.mz: Raw forecast calibration diagnostics cover both model families. The separate applied MZ recalibration covers LightGBM only. Stored audits reproduce the affine formula with its finite fallback and registered positive floor. The unchanged recalibration remains unsuitable to claim predictive improvement.
interpretation.convergence: The single first-pass failed linear component retains its failed status in that attempt. Failed-only Newton resolves a new attempt; already successful components are reused. The new stricter gradient certificate applies to repaired components, not retrospectively to original successes.
interpretation.reproducibility_limit: This projection verifies saved aggregate equality and named metadata hashes. It does not rerun models, read constituent prediction files or certify global process concurrency.
interpretation.window_naming: Primary and confirmation identify the v3 saved windows. The confirmation window is not relabeled as a new prospective replica.
